name: frontend-remediation-verification
description: Verification-only manifest. The application itself ships no build step and no npm dependencies; this file exists so the harness can use the exact third-party versions the browser loads from the CDN (tools/check-cdn-pins.cjs enforces that they stay in step).

scripts.test:static: node ../tools/vue-file-size-check.cjs && node ../tools/vue-custom-lint.cjs && node ../tools/vue-script-setup-coverage.cjs && node ../tools/i18n.js check && node ../tools/check-cdn-pins.cjs && node ../tools/validate-reports.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:static && npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser && npm run test:history
